name: Docker Logs
description: Your Docker Compose containers in Orca: live logs with errors highlighted, stack traces that open the code, CPU and memory history, ports, start/stop/rebuild, a shell, and Ask agent.

cover.alt: Docker Logs: a sidebar panel listing Compose services with CPU, memory and ports above a live container log

screenshots.alt: Docker Logs panel: Compose services with CPU and memory charts, ports and actions, above an api log with a linked Python traceback
screenshots.caption: CPU and memory history and ports per service; the log with errors highlighted and the stack trace linked to the code

screenshots.alt: The same Docker Logs panel in a light theme
screenshots.caption: CPU and memory history and ports per service; the log with errors highlighted and the stack trace linked to the code

screenshots.alt: Two panels: every service’s log merged and tagged by container, and the same log filtered to errors only
screenshots.caption: All services in one log, and errors only, ready for Ask agent

settings.title: Docker CLI path
settings.description: Absolute path to the docker binary. Leave empty to find it on PATH, in /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin or Docker Desktop.

settings.title: Default Compose files
settings.description: Workspace-relative Compose files (comma separated) used in every workspace that has them and no own Compose settings, such as devop/docker-compose.yml. A .env next to the first file is used for its variables.

settings.title: Agent for “Ask agent”
settings.description: Agent Orca starts with the log when you press Ask agent, such as claude or codex.

settings.title: Notify when a container fails
settings.description: Desktop notification when a container of the focused project crashes, keeps restarting or turns unhealthy.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Docker containers of the focused project
